text: Control Science and Engineering is a discipline that studies how to achieve precise control and automation of dynamic systems through "system modeling - analysis - design - optimization", integrating mathematics, electronics, computer science and mechanical engineering. Its core objective is to enable machines, equipment or systems to "act on demand" - from the temperature regulation of air conditioners to the attitude control of rockets, from the intelligent scheduling of industrial production lines to the autonomous obstacle avoidance of smart vehicles. This major has established the theoretical foundation of modern automation and intelligence, and is hailed as the "industrial brain" and the "nerve center of intelligent systems".
